name: SleepWakePlugin
description: Plugin for sleep and wake with volume fade out / ramp up. Scheduling by workdays and weekend.
author: Mario Ivancic

volumio_info.details: Plugin for sleep and wake with volume fade out / ramp up. Scheduling by workdays and weekend.
volumio_info.changelog: 2.0.2: Fixed scheduling across month/year boundaries that could cause repeated, overlapping wake ramps driving the volume up indefinitely. Guarded against overlapping fade/ramp processes, made logging and REST calls non-blocking, and general cleanup.
